name: Britannia NutriChoice oats chocolate & almond
ingredients_raw: Wheat Flour (Atta) (18%), Refined Palm Oil, Sugar, Rolled Oats (15%), Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Chocolate Chips (8%) [Sugar, Cocoa Solids, Cocoa Butter, Dextrose, Emulsifier [322(i)] And Natural Flavouring Substances], Maltodextrin, Milk Solids, Raising Agents [503(ii), 500(ii) & 450(i)], Almond (1.6%), Oats Fibre (1.6%), Wheat Bran, Cocoa Solids, Liquid Glucose, Butter, Invert Sugar Syrup, Emulsifiers [322(i), 471 & 472e], Iodised Salt, Flavours [Natural, Nature Identical And Artificial (Milk & Chocolate) Flavouring Substances] And Colour (150d).
